title: Reinforcement Learning Under Runtime Confounding: Policy Learning and Off-Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40056v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to train robust, adaptable systems across healthcare, e-commerce, and robotics. In these settings, legal, ethical, or logistical concerns may preclude certain key variables that drive decisions from being collected during deployment time. This gives rise to a setting known as runtime confounding: the logged data hold full observability, but deployment time lacks knowledge of certain variables, known as runtime confounders. Unlike single timepoint and non-adaptive settings, runtime confounding under reinforcement learning has the potential to propagate over time, as earlier decisions affect future states, observations, and action assignments, leading to biased learning. translated_title: 运行时混淆下的强化学习：策略学习与离线策略评估
translated_abstract: 强化学习越来越多地被用于在医疗保健、电子商务和机器人等领域训练鲁棒、可适应的系统。在这些场景中，由于法律、伦理或后勤方面的限制，某些驱动决策的关键变量可能在部署时无法被收集。这就产生了一种被称为“运行时混淆”的设定：记录的数据具有完全可观测性，但部署时缺乏对某些变量（即运行时混淆变量）的了解。与单时间点的非自适应设定不同，强化学习下的运行时混淆有可能随时间传播，因为早期决策会影响未来的状态、观测和动作分配，从而导致有偏的学习。我们通过三项贡献来解决这些问题：(1) 在运行时混淆条件下开发策略学习算法，(2) 开发半参数有效的离线策略估计方法，(3) 提供诊断……
tldr: 该论文针对强化学习中部署时关键变量不可观测的“运行时混淆”问题，提出了相应的策略学习算法和半参数高效的离线策略评估方法，以解决混淆随时间传播所导致的学习偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper tackles runtime confounding in reinforcement learning—where key decision-driving variables are unobserved at deployment time—by proposing policy learning algorithms and semi-parametric efficient off-policy evaluation procedures to mitigate bias that propagates over time.
